subject: Belinda Sutton Black History Month Event
overview: The commission planned a Black History Month event commemorating Belinda Sutton's 1783 petition to be held at the Royall House and Slave Quarters. Commissioners also voted to authorize representatives to speak before the City Council in support of a surveillance oversight ordinance.

items.title: Belinda Sutton Black History Month Event Planning
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed the draft schedule, title, logistics, and programming for a February 25 Black History Month event commemorating Belinda Sutton and her 1783 petition for reparations, addressing scheduling conflicts and volunteer assignments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to approve the previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Community Control of Public Surveillance (CCOPS) Ordinance
items.summary: The commission voted to empower Munir Jirmanus and Chelli Keshavan to speak on its behalf at the City Council in favor of a proposed Community Control of Public Surveillance ordinance.

items.title: Police Shooting Statement and Future Business
items.summary: Members discussed drafting a future resolution regarding the Cambridge police killing of Sayed Faisal and agreed to place officer vacancies and Safe Medford proposals on the next meeting's agenda.
